{{Quote|I am Inquisitor Jorad. And I am most interested in who ''you'' might be.|Jorad|<ref name="Sword" />}}
'''Jorad''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[New Order/Legends|new regime]] began [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|hunting]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Jorad became wanted, and he was captured by members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], a group of [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] who served the Empire as [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]]. They turned Jorad to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and he himself became an Inquisitor. Jorad was sent to carry out his new duties on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]], where the [[Citadel Inquisitorius|headquarters]] of the Inquisitorius was located. He carried out patrols in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Prak City]], where he searched for [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users. When a team of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents traveled to Prakith to free [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denia]], who had been captured by the Inquisitorius, Jorad located the agents in Prak [[City/Legends|City]]. He engaged them in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] and attempted to capture them.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My time away from the Citadel is seldom rewarding, but something tells me that you will make this a very interesting trip! ''Very interesting ''indeed''.|Jorad|<ref name="Sword" />}}
Jorad was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Within the Order, he became a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]],<ref name="Sword" /> a combat-orientated [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] specialization.<ref name="Roleplaying">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> However, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the leader of the Republic, issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], calling for the [[Death/Legends|execution]] of the Jedi. The Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> but Jorad was able to survive the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi purge]] that the regime subsequently implemented. However, he was eventually captured by members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], an order of [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] who served the Empire as [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]]. They turned Jorad to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and he joined their order, taking up the title of "Inquisitor."<ref name="Sword" />

[[File:Prakith_RPG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|As an Imperial Inquisitor, Jorad was stationed on the planet Prakith.]]
Jorad was assigned to begin carrying out his new duties on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where the Inquisitorius was based. His role there was to patrol the planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Prak City]], to locate any [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] there. He took any whom he found to the [[Citadel Inquisitorius]], the headquarters of the Inquisitorius, for questioning. After Inquisitor [[Valin Draco]] imprisoned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denia]] in the Citadel<ref name="Sword" /> around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' module ''[[Echoes of the Jedi]]'' states that the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, ''Dawn of Defiance'' must be set around 17 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[Alderaanian Resistance]]&mdash;a group of anti-Imperial rebels from the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]&mdash;sent a group of agents to Prakith to rescue her. They passed through the [[Work Zone sector]] of Prak [[City/Legends|City]], where Jorad was patrolling aboard a [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class shuttle]] along with a [[Prak City Guards|Prak City Guard Squad]].<ref name="Sword" />

After Jorad detected the presence of the agents, he planned to arrest them. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] swooped down toward a clearing where the Resistance team was standing, and Jorad and the guards disembarked. The shuttle then took off again, and Jorad approached the Resistance agents while his guards flanked him on all four sides. Jorad introduced himself to the rebels and attempted to arrest them; however, they resisted, and he ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and engaged them in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="Sword" />

==Personality and traits==
Jorad was prideful, which made him vulnerable to the dark side and allowed him to easily adapt to the role of an Inquisitor. He was also ambitious, and when he was assigned to serve on Prakith, he hoped to make a significant arrest so that he could get off patrol duty and take up a more important position in the Citadel Inquisitorius. In an attempt to achieve this, he used all forms of trickery and deception that were available to him to capture [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users alive.<ref name="Sword" />

==Powers and abilities==
Jorad was Force-sensitive and was able to [[Force power/Legends|use]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to move people and objects, as well as use [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]] to influence the minds of his opponents. He was bilingual and had the ability to speak both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]].<ref name="Sword" />

When attacking a Force-user, one of Jorad's favored tactics was to hide or feint. This allowed him to draw his opponent closer to him so that he could use the Force to knock them over and then engage them in melee combat. He would also capture weak, non-Force-sensitive opponents to use as hostages. Jorad was capable at melee combat and would attack targets with both his lightsaber and a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Sword" />

==Equipment==
As an Inquisitor, Jorad wore [[Color/Legends|red]] and black colored [[Robe/Legends|robes]], the standard uniform for members of his order. He also carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]], and a [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]], which could be used to activate an [[Turbolift/Legends|elevator]] in the Citadel Inquisitorius. He also owned both a lightsaber and a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]].<ref name="Sword" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jorad was created by writer [[John Jackson Miller]] for ''[[Sword of the Empire]]'', the ninth scenario in the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, a [[Wizards of the Coast]] online supplement to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''<ref name="Sword" /> that released on [[May 7]], [[2009]].<ref name="Release date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/dodcampaign|text=The Dawn of Defiance Campaign}}</ref>

In the supplement, Jorad's encounter with the players, who [[Roleplaying game|role-play]] as the team of Resistance agents, can begin in a number of ways. When they arrive in Prak City, if any of them use the Force while they are there, the Inquisitorius detect this and Jorad is sent to investigate. If the players fail to trigger the encounter with Jorad this way, it occurs after they have met with the [[Stereb]] [[Herdr'tui]], when Jorad finds them during a random search of the city. If the players defeat Jorad, they can take his code cylinder and use it later in the scenario to assist them in gaining entry to the Citadel Inquisitorius.<ref name="Sword" />
